raw_posts.tagline: Create, edit, and animate images with AI
raw_posts.description: Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, more precise editing, and native GIF creation to ChatGPT, Codex, and the API. Create looping animations, maintain character and product consistency across edits, export SVGs, and control generation complexity.

raw_posts.name: LiveReview
raw_posts.tagline: Free, Risk-Aware Code Review: Auto Approve Low-Risk Changes
raw_posts.description: Most AI review tools flag issues. LiveReview promises production results: fewer incidents, fewer rollbacks, less senior reviewer load. Every PR is risk-scored. The lowest-risk 30-50% are safely auto-approved; the risky ones go straight to the engineers who should see them. The approach is inspired by Meta's highly successful internal AI review system, where production incidents fell 50x and rollbacks 3x. LLM + incident-trained ML + code-graph analysis. Free and self-hostable.

raw_posts.name: Quest
raw_posts.tagline: Your personal AI advisor for a more intentional life
raw_posts.description: Most AI assistants help you get things done. Quest takes the time to understand your personality, values, ambitions, and motivations. More than just remembering conversations, it's a personal AI advisor that helps you reflect, navigate difficult choices, and make decisions aligned with who you are. Not another assistant telling you what to do, but a thoughtful advisor helping you find your own path.

raw_posts.name: Exa Monitors v2
raw_posts.tagline: Web search on a schedule that calls your agent, $2/1k runs
raw_posts.description: Exa Monitors v2 is web search on a schedule for AI agents. Describe what to watch, pick an interval, and Exa calls your webhook only when something new and relevant turns up, with a summary or JSON output and citations. Per Exa, v2 remembers what it has already sent, is quieter than v1, and costs $2 per 1k runs, down from $15. Watch prices, news, competitors, people and more. Python SDK and API available.

raw_posts.name: GPT‑6 Cyber
raw_posts.tagline: OpenAI’s cyber model, with vetted access for defenders
raw_posts.description: GPT-6 Cyber is OpenAI’s cybersecurity model, which per OpenAI pairs stronger security research with better alignment. It powered OpenAI’s Linux kernel research. Rated Critical in cybersecurity, it starts with a small group of vetted Daybreak Red customers, with identity checks, MFA and an application required. OpenAI says broader access is expected over the coming weeks. No public pricing yet.

raw_posts.name: Google Omni 1.2 Flash
raw_posts.tagline: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: 15s AI video at $0.07 per second
raw_posts.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is Google DeepMind’s video generation and editing model, now generally available. Per Google, clips run up to 15 seconds, up from 10, and 720p costs $0.07 per second, 30% less than Omni 1.1. New: multi-turn editing without regenerating, steadier characters and styles, clearer lip-sync and smoother camera moves. Draft at 360p or 720p, then upscale to 1080p or 4K. In the Gemini API, Google Cloud, Flow and Vids.

raw_posts.name: Muse Realtime Avatar
raw_posts.tagline: Turn voice chats with Muse into live video calls
raw_posts.description: Muse Realtime Avatar gives Meta's Muse agent a face you can video chat with. Voice and video come from one speech stream, so lips, expressions, gestures and posture move with every word, and the reply starts in about 870 ms. Unlike talking-head avatars that only animate a face, it moves hands and full body too, and the character stays consistent from turn to turn. In Meta's live-call tests, raters preferred it 78% of the time over Runway Characters and 88% over HeyGen LiveAvatar.
